description: Source code defining the terrain_type class and a function to create terrain maps for the Wesnoth game, including constructors, accessors, and a map creation function.

classes.name: terrain_type
classes.description: Represents different terrain types in the game, with properties like symbol, name, id, and attributes such as height adjustment, submerge level, and special flags.

methods.name: terrain_type::terrain_type
methods.description: Default constructor initializing terrain type with default values.

methods.name: terrain_type::terrain_type(const config& cfg)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes terrain type based on configuration data.

methods.name: terrain_type::symbol_image
methods.description: Returns the symbol image associated with the terrain.

methods.name: terrain_type::name
methods.description: Returns the name of the terrain.

methods.name: terrain_type::id
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the terrain.

methods.name: terrain_type::letter
methods.description: Returns the character representing the terrain.

methods.name: terrain_type::is_nonnull
methods.description: Checks if the terrain has a non-null character.

methods.name: terrain_type::type
methods.description: Returns the type string of the terrain.

methods.name: terrain_type::is_light
methods.description: Checks if the terrain is light.

methods.name: terrain_type::is_alias
methods.description: Checks if the terrain is an alias of another terrain.

methods.name: terrain_type::unit_height_adjust
methods.description: Returns the height adjustment for units on this terrain.

methods.name: terrain_type::unit_submerge
methods.description: Returns the submerge level of the terrain.

methods.name: terrain_type::gives_healing
methods.description: Checks if the terrain provides healing.

methods.name: terrain_type::is_village
methods.description: Checks if the terrain is a village.

methods.name: terrain_type::is_castle
methods.description: Checks if the terrain is a castle.

methods.name: terrain_type::is_keep
methods.description: Checks if the terrain is a keep.

methods.name: create_terrain_maps
methods.description: Creates maps of terrain types from configuration data, populating lists and maps for terrain lookup.
